text:
Maya K: Hey folks — opened PR https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4821 (tf: gpu-pool + natgw route changes). Can someone take a quick look? need 1 more network approval before we can merge during tonight's canary window.

Anil R: On it, will review in ~30m :eyes:

Jen L: quick flag — this changes the egress route for gpu-subnet-prod, are we sure the cross-account peering has the right route propagation? last time we forgot the propagate-from tag.

Maya K: good catch. snippet from the plan: ```~ aws_route.main: (new resource required) + route_table_id = "rtb-0a1b2c3d" + destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0" + nat_gateway_id = "nat-07ab9cde"``` also adds tag on gpu-pool: "env:prod,gpu:dgx".

Samir P: I skimmed the diff — two things: 1) please add `depends_on = [aws_vpc_peering_connection.gpu-peer]` to the route so it doesn't apply before peering is ready. 2) add a lifecycle block to the gpu-pool module for `ignore_changes = ["tags[\"cost-center\"]"]` if ops will flip tags during canary.

Maya K: adding depends_on now. about lifecycle: ops confirmed they will not mutate cost-center during canary, but we can add the ignore to be safe.

Anil R: also please tighten the SG egress rule — current rule is 0.0.0.0/0 tcp:0-65535, change to 443 only for control plane.

Maya K: done (pushed a new commit). CI plan passed: `terraform plan: 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy` — deploy-bot screenshot below. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: terraform plan for branch feature/tf-gpu-e2e at commit d4f8c3 -> 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.

Jen L: I can approve once Anil's SG suggestion is in. timeline: can we hold merge until 01:00 UTC canary start? we should have at least one hour of smoke traffic before full roll. :clock1:

Anil R: SG change looks good, approving now. :thumbsup:

Samir P: approving but request we run a quick smoke test post-merge: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://gpu-service.prod.internal/health` — should return 200 under 300ms. I'll run it from prod-canary after merge.

Maya K: thanks all. I'll merge at 01:15 UTC (merge + canary start at 01:30) if no other objections. tagging oncall for visibility. :pray:

Jen L: noted, leaving hold until canary start. thanks.

Maya K: merging now (will watch canary).
